name: Sparse4D on Tenstorrent
description: Sparse4D v3 multi-camera 3D object detection (ICCV 2023) ported to Tenstorrent with TT-NN, evaluated on the full nuScenes validation set. A pure TT-NN build runs on stock ops; the recommended build adds four custom Metalium kernels and a grid_sample patch, bringing one 6-camera sample from 235 ms to 57 ms on an n300. Every change carries its own measurement in the changelog.
author: koreaygj
